research: [spread] Reverse line movement: LSU opened -9.5 and was pushed down to -8.5 while 59% of spread tickets were on LSU (TheSpread, Oct 10 2026); Oddschecker had ~60% of tickets and ~64% of handle on LSU at -8.5. The move against the public suggests sharper money on Kentucky. Helps Kentucky +9.5.
[spread] The total fell from 55.5 to 50.5 (TheSpread, Oct 10 2026). A lower-scoring game makes a 9.5-point margin harder. Helps Kentucky.
[spread] Oddschecker's model made LSU about -8, inside the +9.5 we hold (Oddschecker, Oct 10 2026). Helps Kentucky.

LSU's defense is No. 2 in adjusted EPA/play and No. 1 in the SEC in total defense (220.6 ypg), 4th nationally against the run (58.4 ypg) (SI Betting Oct 6; FLM Oct 6; TheSpread Oct 10 2026). Helps LSU.

LSU leads the SEC in total offense (547.8 ypg), is 12th nationally in third-down conversions, and has outscored opponents 98-20 since its loss at Ole Miss, including a 35-6 win over Texas A&M (FLM Oct 6; TheSpread Oct 10 2026). Helps LSU.
Kentucky ranks last in FBS in third-down conversion (24.5%), 131st in third/fourth-down success, and 122nd in third-down defense (TheSpread Oct 10; SI Oct 6 2026). Helps LSU.

[angle] Kentucky's linebacker room is gutted: ILBs Antwan Smith, Alex Afari Jr. and Tavion Wallace plus DBs Jaden Smith and Grant Grayton are out on the SEC availability report (TigerDroppings, Oct 7 2026); Will Stein called the secondary short-handed (FLM Oct 6). Helps LSU.

[angle] LSU is also missing LB Whit Weeks, TE Trey'Dez Green, S Dashawn Spears, WR Phillip Wright III and LB Charles Ross II (TigerDroppings Oct 7 2026); Lane Kiffin: 'I'd feel really good about our team if it weren't for the injuries' (FLM Oct 6). QB Sam Leavitt is off the injury report after a hamstring issue but has 7 INTs, tied for most nationally (TheSpread Oct 10). Helps Kentucky.

Kentucky is 4-1 with a 31-21 road win over then-No. 9 Texas A&M and a 35-34 OT comeback from 17-0 down vs South Carolina; it averages 34.6 ppg and QB Kenny Minchey has 11 TD, 1 INT (FLM Oct 6; TheSpread Oct 10 2026). Kentucky can score enough to stay inside 9.5. Helps Kentucky.
Kentucky has 22 sacks (2nd nationally) and 6 interceptions, against an LSU QB who has thrown 7 picks (TheSpread, Oct 10 2026). Turnover path for the underdog. Helps Kentucky.

[angle] Night homecoming game at Kroger Field; LSU hasn't won in Lexington since 2002, and Stein is the first Kentucky coach to win his first two SEC road games (TheSpread Oct 10; search summary Oct 2026). Slight help to Kentucky.
[angle] Look-ahead: four of LSU's next five are Mississippi State, Alabama, Texas and Tennessee (SI Betting Oct 6 2026). Slight help to Kentucky.
Kentucky's defense is 96th in run success rate and 13th in SEC total defense (376.6 ypg) (SI Oct 6; FLM Oct 6 2026). Helps LSU.
games.reasoning: LSU is the better team, but the market went against 60% of the tickets, from 9.5 to 8.5, and the total fell five points. Kentucky has a top-two pass rush, a 34.6-ppg offense and home field against an LSU team missing several starters with an interception-prone QB. I project LSU by about 7, so +9.5 is the side. The [angle] that worried me most is Kentucky's three missing inside linebackers against LSU's offense. Steam toward LSU would have made it a pass.

research: [spread] Game-day line flip: TeamRankings' history shows USC +1.5 to +2.5 through the morning of Oct 10, then moving to USC -1.5 across books from about 3 PM ET on game day (TeamRankings spread movement, Oct 10 2026). Late money on USC. Helps USC +1.5.

[spread] USC is 1-5 ATS this season and 5-8 ATS in 2025 (1-4 on the road); Penn State is 2-3 ATS (2-1 at home) (NBC Sports, Oct 6 2026). Helps Penn State on form, though Covers called it a USC 'buy-low' spot.
[spread] Penn State is 1-5 ATS in its last six games as a favorite of less than a touchdown (Covers, Oct 10 2026). Helps USC.
Penn State's run defense ranks 133rd in EPA/rush allowed and 135th in rushing explosiveness allowed; it gave up 413 rushing yards and 4 TDs to Northwestern last week (Covers, Oct 10 2026). Helps USC.

USC's offense is 8th in success rate and scores 37.3 ppg; QB Jayden Maiava averages 9.1 yards per attempt; RB Waymond Jordan leads the Big Ten with a 37% missed-tackles-forced rate (Covers Oct 10; NBC Oct 6 2026). Helps USC.

Penn State's offense is 99th in success rate, 103rd on standard downs and 118th in line yards; QB Rocco Becht has 1 passing TD and 3 INTs on the season, including 2 at Northwestern (Covers Oct 10; NBC Oct 6 2026). Helps USC.

[angle] Penn State is 3-2 and 0-2 in the Big Ten after losses to Wisconsin (24-20) and Northwestern (34-13) under first-year coach Matt Campbell, and its defense has allowed 861 yards in the last two games (NBC Sports, Oct 6 2026). Helps USC.
[angle] Penn State's top deep threat, WR Koby Howard (team-high 344 yds, 28.7 per catch), misses a third straight game (Covers, Oct 10 2026). Helps USC.

Penn State's defense is still 24th in scoring (16.0 ppg), and PFF ranks it 6th overall; USC's defense allows 25.5 ppg (89th) and ranks 70th in success rate (NBC Oct 6; Covers Oct 10 2026). Helps Penn State.
USC LB Desman Stephens II returns from a one-game suspension; freshmen Trent Mosley and Mark Bowman are questionable (NBC Oct 6; Covers Oct 10 2026). Slight help to USC.

[angle] Night game at Beaver Stadium, USC's first road game of note since a 0-1 ATS road mark; USC is 1-0 road straight up and comes off a 25-21 home win over Washington (NBC Sports, Oct 6 2026). Slight help to Penn State (environment).
Head-to-head: Penn State won the last meeting 33-30 in OT in 2024; USC has won 3 of 4 since 2000 (NBC Sports, Oct 6 2026). Neutral (old history).
games.reasoning: This season's matchup data point one way: USC's top-10 offense and running game against a Penn State run defense ranked 133rd that just allowed 413 rushing yards, while Penn State's offense ranks near 100th. The market flipped to USC as the favorite on game day, so getting +1.5 is a good number. The [angle] is Penn State's 0-2 Big Ten start under a new staff, without its top receiver. USC's 1-5 ATS mark is the main counterweight, and the reason this is a lean, not strong.

research: [spread] Big line swing: Georgia opened as a 3-point favorite (SI Betting, Oct 5 2026; TheSpread says Georgia -1 open), and by game day Alabama was -2.5 (TheSpread, Oct 10 2026). The slate's Alabama -1.5 is better than the close. Helps Alabama.

[spread] Splits: public tickets heavily on Georgia (about 75%) while Alabama took about two-thirds of the handle (pre-game splits report via search, Oct 2026); TheSpread showed 50/50 tickets and read the move as sharp money (Oct 10 2026). Don't fade sharp money. Helps Alabama.

[spread] Both teams are 4-1 ATS and 5-0 to the over; Alabama is 2-1 ATS at home and 8-4-1 ATS vs ranked teams since 2024; Georgia is 7-7 ATS vs ranked teams since 2024 (NBC Sports, Oct 7 2026). Helps Alabama slightly.
Alabama ranks 2nd in net adjusted EPA/play and 1st in offensive success rate; Georgia's defense is 67th in net adjusted EPA/play and 69th in EPA/pass (SI Betting, Oct 5 2026). Helps Alabama.
Alabama QB Keelon Russell: 71.2%, 1,414 yds, 11 TD, 2 INT plus 184 rush yds and 4 rush TDs; his Heisman odds moved from +1600 to +750 after Week 5 (SI Betting Oct 5 2026). Helps Alabama.

Georgia leads FBS at 51.4 ppg, allows 13.4 ppg (12th) and 57.4 rush ypg (3rd fewest), has not allowed more than 20 points or trailed all season; QB Gunner Stockton has a 13:1 TD:INT ratio and 75.7% completions (NBC Oct 7; TheSpread Oct 10 2026). Helps Georgia.
[angle] Georgia will be without RB Chauncey Bowens, and DL Amaris Williams is out for the season (knee); Nate Frazier carries the load (TheSpread, Oct 10 2026). Helps Alabama.

[angle] Forecast of rain and 20+ mph wind in Tuscaloosa (NBC Sports, Oct 7 2026); the total fell from 55.5 to 51.5 (TheSpread Oct 10). Lower scoring shrinks margins and makes a 1.5-point spread near a coin flip. Neutral, slight help to the dog Georgia.

[angle] Georgia has not won in Tuscaloosa since 2007; Alabama leads the series 45-27-4 and has won 10 of the last 12, but Georgia won the last meeting, the 2025 SEC title game (TheSpread Oct 10; NBC Oct 7 2026). Old history, small help to Alabama.
Alabama's red-zone defense allows scores 92.9% of the time (117th), and its scoring defense is 51st (20.8 ppg) (NBC Sports, Oct 7 2026). Helps Georgia.
Georgia is 3-1 ATS as an underdog since 2021 and 6-3 since 2017 (NBC Sports, Oct 7 2026). Helps Georgia.
Expert picks split: SI's Dewey on Alabama ML; NBC's Dalzell, TheSpread and ClutchPoints on Georgia (Oct 5-10 2026). Neutral.
games.reasoning: The market moved 4.5 points to Alabama against heavy public Georgia tickets, Alabama's efficiency profile is better (2nd net EPA vs Georgia's 67th on defense), and Georgia is short a running back and a starting defensive lineman. I make Alabama about a 3.5-point favorite, and we hold -1.5 when the market closed -2.5. The [angle] holding this to a lean is the rain and 20+ mph wind forecast, which shrinks margins in a near pick'em.

research: Utah is 4-0 (No. 12), allows 10.3 ppg (Big 12 best) and 258.5 ypg, and scores 43.3 ppg; Kansas is 2-2 (0-1 Big 12) (Roundtable Oct 9; SportsBettingDime Oct 10 2026). Helps Utah.

[spread] The market priced Utah -15.5 at most books and -16.5 on Kalshi as of Oct 9; Scores&Stats' model had Utah by 16.8; numberFire gave Utah a 91% win chance (search summary of SBD, Scores&Stats, FanDuel previews, Oct 8-10 2026). Projection sits right on the number.
[spread] Utah has failed to cover in 4 of its last 5 games as a top-15 AP team at Rice-Eccles (Pickdawgz, Oct 9 2026). Helps Kansas.

[spread] Kansas has failed to cover in 8 of its last 9 October road underdog games and lost its last 7 games as an underdog; it is 1-2 SU and ATS in its last three (Pickdawgz, Oct 9 2026). Helps Utah.
Turnover margin: Utah +5 (7 takeaways, 2 giveaways), Kansas -4 (7 giveaways) (SportsBettingDime, Oct 10 2026). Helps Utah.
Kansas leads the Big 12 in total defense (244.8 ypg allowed, 100 rush ypg allowed) and gains 496.8 ypg on offense (Roundtable Oct 9; SBD Oct 10 2026). Helps Kansas stay inside 15.5.

[angle] Kansas comes off a 55-0 shutout of Middle Tennessee with a program-record 700 yards, its first shutout since 2008 (Roundtable, Oct 9 2026). Inflated by a weak opponent; neutral to slight help for Utah (Kansas overvalued).
[angle] Kansas's first true Big 12 road trip, to altitude in Salt Lake City, for a 10:15 PM ET kickoff (Roundtable, Oct 9 2026). Helps Utah.
[angle] Kansas allowed two long kickoff returns vs Middle Tennessee and needs to fix kickoff coverage (Roundtable, Oct 9 2026). Helps Utah.
Utah QB Devon Dampier: 70.3%, 9 TD, 172.2 rating; RB Wayshawn Parker 6.56 ypc and 9 total TDs; Kansas QB Isaiah Marshall: 54.8%, 810 yds, 6 TD (Pickdawgz Oct 9; SBD Oct 10 2026). Helps Utah.
Utah's last game was a 31-17 road win at Iowa State (Roundtable, Oct 9 2026). Helps Utah.
No injury news found for either team in pre-game previews (Roundtable Oct 9; Pickdawgz Oct 9 2026). Neutral; fewer than 10 game-specific findings beyond stats, so confidence is lowered.
games.reasoning: Utah is clearly better, but Kansas's Big 12-best total defense and a 51-point total make 15.5 a fair number, and the market and models sit within a point of it. Conflicting ATS trends (Utah 1-4 as a top-15 home team, Kansas 1-8 as an October road dog) cancel out. Pass. CONTAMINATED: I saw the result before locking (see note); the pass was my pre-game read.
games.contaminationNote: A search for Kansas injury and ATS news returned a summary stating 'The Utes beat the Jayhawks 41-24 on October 10, 2026', plus a Deseret News headline '3 takeaways from Utah's win against Kansas'. I saw this before deciding. I had not chosen a side; I locked a pass based on the pre-game evidence (projection on the number), but the decision came after seeing the result.

research: [spread] Fresno State is 4-1 ATS this season; Boise State is 3-2 ATS (SI Betting, Oct 10 2026). Helps Fresno State.
[spread] Fresno State is 7-3 ATS in the last 10 meetings, and the under is 8-2 in those games (SI Betting, Oct 10 2026). Helps Fresno State +6.5.

[spread] Line steady at Boise -6.5 (-250 ML) at DraftKings and FanDuel (SI Betting Oct 10; Action Network Oct 2026); SI's writer would lay it only below 7. Key number 7 sits just above the spread. Neutral.
Boise State ranks 18th in adjusted EPA/play and net success rate; Fresno State ranks 79th and 74th (SI Betting, Oct 10 2026). Helps Boise State.
Boise QB Maddux Madsen has 11 TD and 0 INT, 7 TD passes in the last three games; went 17-of-21 for 244 vs Utah State (Field Level Media, Oct 6 2026). Helps Boise State.

[angle] Boise's top weapons are banged up: nation-leading rusher Dylan Riley (685 yds) limped off with a lower-leg injury vs Utah State; WR Rasean Jones (team-high 23 catches, 359 yds) left after a hit to the head and was reported out; Sire Gaines (wrist) has missed two games (Field Level Media Oct 6 2026; Fox Sports pre-game note). Helps Fresno State.

[angle] Revenge spot: Boise lost 30-7 at home to Fresno last season (Madsen hurt in that game) and has lost three straight to the Bulldogs; Fresno hasn't lost to Boise since 2022 (Field Level Media, Oct 6 2026). Motivation helps Boise; series dominance helps Fresno.

Fresno State has won four straight and outscored opponents 139-43 since a 39-0 opening loss at USC; held Washington State to 182 yards in a 26-6 win (Field Level Media, Oct 6 2026). Helps Fresno State.
Fresno RB Rayshon Luke (team-high 286 rush yds) suffered a concussion in the first quarter vs Washington State; status unknown (Field Level Media, Oct 6 2026). Helps Boise State.
Fresno QB Jayden Mandal: 1,034 yds, 6 TD, 1 INT; 24-of-33 for 245 vs Washington State (Field Level Media, Oct 6 2026). Neutral.
Boise's only loss was 34-27 to then-No. 2 Oregon in Week 1; it beat Utah State 37-18 and Western Michigan 32-7 (SI Betting Oct 10; FLM Oct 6 2026). Helps Boise State.

[angle] 10:30 PM ET kickoff in Fresno in Pac-12 play, with Fresno coach Matt Entz calling Boise 'the gold standard for Group of Six football' (Field Level Media, Oct 6 2026). Home underdog night game; slight help to Fresno.
games.reasoning: Boise's efficiency edge (18th vs 79th) points to about a touchdown, but Riley, Jones and Gaines are all hurt, Fresno is 4-1 ATS and 7-3 ATS in the series, and Fresno's lead back is also concussed. I make it Boise by about 5.5, within about 1 point of 6.5, with key players' status deciding it. Pass. CONTAMINATED: I saw the result before locking (see note).
